## toTestSpecification <Version>4.1.0</Version> {#totestspecification}

```ts
function toTestSpecification(): TestSpecification
```

Returns a new [test specification](/api/advanced/test-specification) that can be used to filter or run this specific test suite.

request.answer: Returns a new [test specification](/api/advanced/test-specification) that can be used to filter or run this specific test case.
claims: Returns a new [test specification](/api/advanced/test-specification) that can be used to filter or run this specific test case.
request.instructions: The statement and the source are two sections of the same project's documentation at the same version. Mark the statement contradicted only when the source states an incompatible value, version, limit, name or rule for the same thing in the same scope. If the source is about a different option, hook, function, package or version, the statement is not stated, not contradicted. An example value in a code sample that overrides a default does not contradict the default.
